gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Notebookcheck measured the Lofree Flow Lite84's battery draining 10% per hour on 2.4 GHz with the backlight at maximum (about 10 hours), against 1% per hour on Bluetooth with the backlight off (about 100 hours).
standout_why: Compared against the RTINGS low-profile list (cited), the RTINGS K5 Max vs Air75 V3 compare page, keeb-finder's Air75 V2 / K3 Max / Air75 V3 compare (cited) and mkbguide (cited). keeb-finder and mkbguide carry maker specs only: no latency in ms and no named reviewer's measurement (mkbguide gives the Flow Lite84 'up to ~80 h off'). RTINGS holds the full measured set (latency per connection, travel, force, height, weight, loudness) for the Air75 V3, K5 Max, Flow 2 and Flow84, but every figure is locked to members, so a side-by-side table of RTINGS numbers could not be built from pages I could open. The only openly readable measurement is Notebookcheck's battery drain for one board, the Flow Lite84, which is not the Flow Lite 2 84 we list. Wirecutter (cited) could not be fetched, and I did not open mechkeyfoundry, technobezz, keebscout or pcreviewer, so the gap is checked against four of the results only.
decides: It confirms rather than changes the pick. RTINGS keeps the NuPhy Air75 V3 as best low-profile keyboard (list updated 2026-10-09) and words its wired and 2.4 GHz latency as excellent. RTINGS names the Lofree Flow 2 as the alternative to the Air75 V3 and rates it 'Superb typing quality' with 'Excellent single-key' latency; the Flow 2 84 we link is under $150 at checkout, so it honestly holds the typing-feel segment (RTINGS tested the 100-key size). RTINGS words the original Flow84/Flow100 wireless performance as 'Exceptionally poor', which argues against the Bluetooth-only Flow84 for anything latency-sensitive. Notebookcheck's drain figures mean a Flow Lite84 buyer on the dongle with full backlight gets about a working day per charge. Keychron's store today lists the K3 Max from $72.49 and the K3 Ultra 8K from $98.99, both lower than ChatGPT showed ($87.49 and $109.99).
